summary: שְׂרוֹךְ names the strap that holds a sandal in place. Abram mentions it alongside a thread as one of the smallest things he might take.

senses.definition: A strap used to fasten a sandal.

evidence.note: Abram names a thread and the strap of a sandal in his oath to take nothing belonging to the king.
The description of the advancing soldiers says that no sandal strap has come loose.

note: Root (2026-11-21): Kept under שׂרכ: scripture's verb in מְשָׂרֶכֶת דְּרָכֶיהָ "twisting her ways" (Jer 2:23) gives the strap as what is twisted or laced.
